title: Tata Sons Court Row: No Relief for Trusts ⚖️ 28 Nov Brief | StickBiz Brief | 28 Nov 2026
ticker: No court relief for Tata Trusts; Tata Sons board meets 30 Nov
Flipkart CEO leaves 4 Dec; Walmart's Nicholas visits 30 Nov
India's October inflation 6.09%, above RBI ceiling
FSSAI sanctions prosecution against Bisleri over Bengal sample

quote.text: The secret of getting ahead is getting started.

segments.headline: Tata board meet goes ahead · Flipkart CEO exit, staff payout
segments.cap: Tata Trusts ko court se relief nahi mila. Aur India ki inflation 6.09% par pahunch gayi.
segments.tts: [excited] Tata Trusts ko court se relief nahi mila. Aur India ki inflation छह point शून्य नौ percent par pahunch gayi.

segments.headline: Tata board meet goes ahead
segments.cap: Bombay High Court ne Tata Trusts ko interim relief nahi diya. Tata Sons ki board meeting 30 November ko hogi, par faisle court ke final order par depend karenge. Trusts ke paas 66% hai, aur RBI ne Tata Sons ki listing zaroori kar di hai.
segments.tts: [excited] Bombay High Court ne Tata Trusts ko interim relief nahi diya. Tata Sons ki board meeting तीस November ko hogi, par faisle court ke final order par depend karenge. Trusts ke paas छियासठ percent hai, aur RBI ne Tata Sons ki listing zaroori kar di hai.

head: NO RELIEF
FOR TRUSTS
beats.note: The court refused any *interim relief*, so the Tata Trusts could not *stop the board meeting.*

head: MEETING
ON 30 NOV
beats.note: The meeting can go on, but any decision stays *subject to the court's final order.*

head: 66% STAKE
& LISTING?
beats.note: The trusts own *66%* of Tata Sons, and the RBI has *made a listing mandatory.*

segments.headline: Flipkart CEO exit, staff payou
segments.cap: Flipkart ke CEO Kalyan Krishnamurthy ka last day 4 December hai. Reports ke mutabiq Walmart ke Chris Nicholas 30 November ko employees se milenge, aur ESOP holders ke liye cash payout ka plan aa sakta hai.
segments.tts: [excited] Flipkart ke CEO Kalyan Krishnamurthy ka last day चार December hai. Reports ke mutabiq Walmart ke Chris Nicholas तीस November ko employees se milenge, aur ESOP holders ke liye cash payout ka plan aa sakta hai.

head: FLIPKART
CEO EXITS
beats.note: Kalyan Krishnamurthy's *last day is 4 December*, and Balaji Thiagarajan will *lead in the interim.*

head: CASH PAYOUT
FOR ESOPS?
beats.note: The IPO is delayed, so staff want cash for options. The *amount is not final* yet.

segments.headline: Inflation crosses RBI ceiling
segments.cap: October mein retail inflation 6.09% rahi, jo 2 saal mein pehli baar RBI ke ceiling se upar gayi. Finance Ministry ke mutabiq aane wale mahino mein inflation aur badh sakti hai, lekin crude $100 se neeche hai.
segments.tts: [excited] October mein retail inflation छह point शून्य नौ percent rahi, jo दो saal mein pehli baar RBI ke ceiling se upar gayi. Finance Ministry ke mutabiq aane wale mahino mein inflation aur badh sakti hai, lekin crude एक सौ डॉलर se neeche hai.

head: INFLATION
HITS 6.09%
beats.note: It is the *first time in 2 years* that inflation went above the RBI's *upper limit.*

head: MORE RISE
AHEAD?
beats.note: Festive and *wedding demand* may push prices up, while crude *below $100* and a firmer rupee may help.

segments.headline: FSSAI acts against Bisleri
segments.cap: FSSAI ne Bisleri ke khilaf prosecution sanction kiya, kyunki West Bengal ke sample mein coliform bacteria mila. Bisleri kehti hai ki 2 independent labs mein sample pass hua, aur company ne testing review karne ko kaha hai.
segments.tts: [excited] FSSAI ne Bisleri ke khilaf prosecution sanction kiya, kyunki West Bengal ke sample mein coliform bacteria mila. Bisleri kehti hai ki दो independent labs mein sample pass hua, aur company ne testing review karne ko kaha hai.

head: BISLERI
SAMPLE FAILS
beats.note: A West Bengal batch was found *unsafe* with *coliform bacteria*, and it is the second such action after Goa.

head: TWO LABS
DISAGREE
beats.note: The batch was recalled, but Bisleri says *2 independent labs* passed it and wants a *review of testing.*
